answer: Layered bond: one identity stakes three layers. First, 30 credits open a cedar file. A violet seal closes it. Next, 60 credits release after two verified jobs proved by a pulse. Last, 90 lock ten epochs; a copied pulse burns all three. Fees climb: first 30, k-th 30+4(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,028,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented layers fail: a foreign pulse burns them, slashing the lender. Honest agents pay 30 once, keep full share.
